question: T12 (task-4cbaae7d818cec62): Cmd+Z in a Scrolling block's link field. A new section and Scrolling block on Blocks Probe at 1600 by 1000, Edit, Content, Attach link, the About page picked (or nothing picked), then Cmd+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z, Escape, a press away (the panel's Content tab) or the Undo button, read after each step. Two clean rounds (R1, R2) in one Chrome session, each scenario on its own entry, nothing saved. J1 (2026-11-23, oracleJ, its own Chrome session): Z13, Attach link with nothing picked, then Escape three times and Cmd+Z.
readsAre: block: the new block's state in its section (n blocks, gone, data-is-selected, desktop grid area, opacity; others: other blocks' area and selected); pop: the link editor's field [value, left, top] or null when closed, options: page rows showing, linkRow: the panel's Link row texts; focus: [document, tag, label, value] of the focused element; undo: [name, disabled] for Save, Undo, Redo. Each scenario on a fresh section and Scrolling block, left by Exit Without Saving (exits).
answer: Z8 (R1, R2): after a page pick on Attach link, Cmd+Z in the field takes the pick: Redo on, the editor stays open, its field focused on /about. A second Cmd+Z changes nothing seen: the block stays, the editor open on /about. The third takes the block and the editor closes.

Z12 (R1, R2): Attach link with nothing picked, Cmd+Z: Redo on, the block and the editor stay; the second Cmd+Z takes the block. Opening Attach link is a step of its own (Z11, R1: with the panel on Content and no link editor, one Cmd+Z takes the block).
Z9 (R1, R2): a pick, a press away (the Link row shows About), then Undo: the link goes; Undo again: nothing seen; the third Undo takes the block.
Z3 (R1, R2): a pick, Cmd+Z, then Escape and Escape again: the editor stays open, field focused on /about; a press away then sets /about again (Link row About), Redo off.
Z4 (R1, R2): a pick, Cmd+Z, a press away: the link is /about again, Redo off; Undo then takes it, Redo on.
Z5 (R1, R2): a pick, Cmd+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z: Redo off; a press away: the link is /about, Redo off.
Z1, Z2, Z6 (R1): the same with Cmd+Z twice, also after one Escape; Z0 (R1): a pick and a press away keeps /about.

Z10 (R1, R2) and Z13 (J1, a fresh session on 2026-11-23): Attach link with nothing picked shows the page list; the first Escape takes the list, and Escape again (and a third time, Z13) leaves the editor open, its empty field focused, Undo and Redo as they were. Cmd+Z after that takes Attach link's step: Redo on, the editor still open.
